Under the King’s Graceful Rule,
Duke Micalico
Royal Commissioner

Safe travels to all under the Crown.

Royal scout ships identified your assigned archipelago as a potential colony as part of the Royal Scouting Commission of 1681. 72 such colonies have successfully been established as a result of those brave Claws’ efforts. By the King’s graceful guidance yours could be the 73rd such colony.

Your most important building will be the Main Dock. Without it your colony cannot repay its debts. Therefore I implore you to choose an island and construct your dock. Look for ample Trees and Berry Bushes nearby.

Warehouses are vital to preserving the market value of your tax contributions. Each warehouse has a limited capacity. Watch that you do not satiate your warehouse’s capacity on worthless goods. Focus on storing resources that will benefit the Kingdom: Logs, Cotton, and Ores.

Those goods will keep during long voyages and supply work for Whiskers in the royal factories. To reduce carry distances, you should construct the included Central Warehouse schematic near your Main Dock.

Congratulations to you and your fellow colonists. Under commission of the King, it is my privilege to offer this Colony Charter.

You embark on a mission worthy of the greatest of Whiskers, and all of your kind shall thank you for your efforts. As you tame these wild lands and earn the payment for your taxes, you are doing more than any Whisker before you. With your sweat, you secure the means by which some industrious Whiskers might enjoy safety. 

Serve your King faithfully and his peace will reign over these islands.

Our stores are meager. We cannot rely on these rations holding beyond two days. Our colony ship contained ample materials to build those royal-designed dock and warehouse buildings yet mere scraps for our personal needs. 

We must find a source of food to survive and somehow pay off the coming tax ship.

Other matters demand your attention. Housing is not a luxury. Some Whiskers have already resorted to makeshift camps. I implore you to provide us shelter. We cannot survive as a colony living out in the elements.

Winter’s arrival will see temperatures plunge, and you cannot fight the cold with fires alone. Homes are our only defense.
Pay taxes by loading resources from warehouses onto the Tax Collector's ship.

Paying taxes to the Crown is your primary responsibility. Most colonies pay their taxes with Ores. Copper pays best, but Coal is more plentiful. Desperate colonies will ship out their construction Logs. You would be wise to choose the path of non-desperation.

Build and fully assign 2 workers to at least 1 Mining Camp.

You have been entrusted by your fellow Whiskers to lead their colony. This is the highest honor any Whisker can attain. The teeming masses of mainland Whiskers are pleading to live in colonies such as yours. They wish only to serve the Crown on a wild island such as yours. Do not disappoint them.

Grow your colony to 21 Whiskers so you can start paying some real taxes.

With the supplied traps we were able to get a hold on the pest population! Thank you for your timely assistance.

Throughout Early Access, we'll be adding content and features, bug fixing, balancing, and generally working to make the game better through all the comments and feedback of the player community. Thank you for your support as we work to make Whiskerwood the best experience possible!

War... war never changes.

...Except during our Early Access period. The war mechanic is not-final, and during development we expect to further refine how war works. We will attempt to maintain save-file compatibility, but that might not be possible for all elements of war. If you trigger a war, it might destroy your colony and you might not be prepared for the onslaught. Please ensure you have a strong economy and large navy before conducting war.

Thank you for playing our preview of Whiskerwood. This is our dream project, and we intend to continue working on it until it is fully complete.

In this demo, you can unlock a selection of the early game schematics, including Railroads and Conveyor Belts. More schematics will be available in the full version of Whiskerwood.

Some gameplay mechanics are a work in progress, and you may experience bugs or spots where we made mistakes. We would like to know if you hit a bug or think of any suggestions. You can either email me at devdaniel@minakatadynamics.co.jp, or you can chat with me and the entire team on Discord.

There have been reports of pirate ransom demands in your part of the world. Under no circumstances are you to yield or to even consider paying their exaction.

Should your colony survive, report back the Pirate’s shakedown tactics.

We are but humble seafarers who, having torn off the shackles of the kingdom, find ourselves in great need. In past times of want, wise and generous Whisker colonies have supplied us with everything they had.

You should follow their example, and do it quickly. There is nothing more detestable and worthy of destruction than a greedy colony.

Droughts in the southern colonies have ruined their Cotton harvests. The kingdom needs additional Cotton supplies. A generous reward has been authorized for any colonies who meet the requested quota.

Plant and harvest 34 Cotton. Cotton seeds are enclosed in this parcel.

Please, may we have better housing? This new island was exciting for a bit, but that excitement has worn off. I wake up each day to the smell of damp.

If our lodgings don’t improve, this island is never going to be a home.

Do you remember the parable of the lazy cat and the busy beavers? How the lazy cat ignored the advice of the beavers and never stocked up food for the winter? How he preferred the comfort of sleeping in the sun over diligent saving…

Winter is coming. We need to be like the busy beavers and build up our food stocks.

We’re out here in the wild. Wind-swept and freezing. Even basic Campfires would be a big help.

Please build 5 Campfires. A few near our homes, and maybe 1 or 2 for the most remote harvesters. Campfires burn dirty, so avoid putting them upwind of crops or in confined areas.

Our fur is not enough to hold back the winter winds. Cloaks will help us keep the warmth of Campfires longer and slow the onset of frostbite.

Please trade or make enough Cloaks for at least 13 Whiskers. More would be appreciated. And don’t forget to place Campfires in strategic locations.
I am so hungry… Please, I need food. I don’t think I can last much longer.

The snow has crept down from the mountains. Now even the shoreline is showing the season. Open containers of water are freezing over. The thought of waking up to the sight of a fellow Whisker frozen in the snow is terrifying. Please build enough houses that 0 Whiskers are left homeless. It was never safe to sleep outdoors, but now it is a death sentence.

Times might be tough, but that is no excuse for neglecting our own town. Decorating the paths and erecting statues will lighten everyone’s mood. Even the Claws cannot deny us such a luxury.

Please decorate at least 8 path segments. We can ask that much, can’t we?

Our King’s generous expansion of the Earl entitlements has opened an opportunity for Whisker Colonies to show their gratitude to the Kingdom. A special volunteer shortfall compensation festival has been declared. Each colony is free to volunteer an additional tax contribution to the Crown.

Your colony has been allocated a volunteer contribution of 877 gold, payable in your next tax shipment. Please pay promptly.
Grow to Prepare for a Bigger Future

Your colony has been found to be undersized. Your tax receipts have not kept pace with an expected growth rate for such a rich island as the one you have been entrusted with.

Reach a population of 84 Whiskers to remove this stain on our records. For Whiskers to count in our records, they must not be deceased.
Spring is the Time for Planting

The insects are waking up for the spring thaw. Now is our chance to maximize this year’s bounty. It is time to plant crops and expand our farms. Plants will grow quickest in the warmth of summer, so these spring months are ours to till the earth and plant seeds.

We Claws are a humble race. We rarely make such uncouth demands as may be our right. Yet it has come to the attention of the kingdom that too few colonies are repaying this humility with proper respect.

Your colony has appeared on such a list. This is your last warning. Build 8 Claw Statues worthy of the grace we have shown the Whiskerkind.

Winters have proven a tough period for some Whisker colonies. If a colony has left themselves unprepared for the challenge, the cold and lack of crop growth leaves them desperate. Sadly, their pleas for rescue arrive at our ministry too late for an official reply.

As such, please accept this preemptive notice: you must survive winter at all costs. There is no rescue boat. There is no alternative choice. Do not waste this colony.

Be it carrying cargo or commuting to work, every Whisker appreciates a good path. A good proper path. Nothing better. I love it when I start going in a direction, and poof – as if someone knew my destination, a perfect path is there to lead me on.

We could use some more good paths.

It feels like every day this cargo gets heavier and heavier. Just yesterday, I almost threw out my back carrying some rocks. Could we have some Conveyor Belts to lighten the load?

Conveyors unlock item transport without the sweat. We need only bring the item to an Input Hopper and away it goes. The conveyor carries it along, and we can get back to our work.

Our records indicate you’ve received more Whiskers than your colony has productive jobs.

Remember: idle hands lead to dangerous thinking. Reduce the unemployed to a manageable population.

Be prepared. The news I am authorized to give you is a grand sign of the King’s generosity. Honor it. Treasure it. Remember this day in your colony’s history.

The king has seen fit to grant your colony the schematic for a Shipyard. This is a technology refined over centuries by Claw engineers. Our royal shipyards are capable of crafting First-Rate ships which smooth the waves and extract peace from pirate-infested waters.

Your colony’s Shipyard will not be as grand as those royal yards, but they will be capable of crafting fishing ships to further increase your ability to serve the crown.

It is time for your colony to return the king’s generosity. Use that new shipyard to start a befitting fishing fleet. At least 1 Fishing Sloop will suffice.

Under no circumstances are you to ever consider abusing these ships to contact other colonies. Smuggling between colonies is punishable by a hundred-cannon sinking.
Long have we suffered under the oppression of the Claws! Now is our chance! With ships of our own, we can find and contact other colonies – or even other nations!

If we can trade our industrial products for gold, we can lighten the burden of paying our taxes. Other islands will be willing to trade their basic resources for our developed products. Claws call this smuggling – as if we owe them even the sweat of our brow!

Set up a trade route and secure gold to pay our taxes, so we can retain more of our production for our own.

Due to circumstances outside our control, a stray cannonball has shattered our ship’s mast.

Since the damages were caused by the carelessness of your Claw masters, we are forced to seek compensation from you. Please provide us with sufficient Planks to repair our ship. You have 3 days, or you will leave us no choice but to bombard your colony.

The Claws will send mostly loyal Monarchist Whiskers. Monarchist Whiskers require less approval to accept and are more happy despite harsh conditions but refuse to smuggle or fight. They believe factories are an affront to the King's generosity.
This part of the ocean is teeming with Pirates. Their ransom demands are greedier but smuggled cargo fetches higher prices. Tax ships are less frequent.
Fewer Monarchist Whiskers are sent this far into the frontier. Tax ships arrive on a normal pace but fewer islands are interested in smuggled cargo.

Welcome to the Whiskerwood Demo!

Whiskerwood is our dream project, and we're very excited to bring you a sneak peek at the early parts of the game ahead of our release later this year!

The demo will let you play for as long as you desire, establishing core production chains to keep your mice happy, and to pay off the ever-increasing tax levied by your feline overlords. How many days can you keep your colony afloat?

When the game releases later this year, you can expect many more production chains, quests, and considerations, including:
109 unique buildable structures
A tech tree with over 50 techs to research
Over 70 types of goods to mine, harvest, or manufacture
Ship building to allow for exploration, trade, and more
Massive maps up to 9 times the size of what's available in the demo

If you have any feedback or suggestions, please let us know so that we can make Whiskerwood the best it can be at launch!

Thank you for playing our game : )

Daniel,
Programmer

Thank you for joining us! As the game is in Game Preview, you can expect some platform features to not work correctly, and you may encounter some bugs and crashes as well. Throughout our time in Game Preview, we'll be adding content and features, fixing bugs, balancing, and generally working to make the game better through all the bug reports and feedback from the community. Please feel free to reach out to us on Discord. Thank you for your support!

My vessel has been damaged beyond my ability to repair!

Without assistance, I dare not fathom what would come of me out on the open sea.

You're an honorable sort, aren't you? Then help a fellow out! I implore you by your good nature!

If you rescue me from my predicament, then by my honour, I will repay you one day! You'll see!

Begging your pardon. 
I know it's not my place to say, but you must build more ships!


The Claws maintain a vast fleet, and if we ever want to escape their filthy clutches, we must grow to match! 


More ships means more freedom. Not so bad a thing, I'd say.


Of course, far be it from a lowly sailor like myself to tell a great whisker such as yourself what to build. I'm sure you'll come to the right decision all on your own.

I've got news for you, but you might not want to hear it. 

As I was pondering on our situation, I realized that we might be needing a bit of a "leg up" when it comes to shipbuilding. 

And I says to myself, "who's got better sea legs than pirates"? 

So I went out, told the pirates about our island, and secured an agreement with them! 

Now I know most Whiskers aren't the type to parley with such "sailors of ill repute", but please don't get angry! Hear me out. It's for the good of the colony, after all.

The pirates have agreed to share with us the secret to building shipyards! And all it will cost us is five measly gold bars! 

'Course, I don't want you thinking I'm some kind of freebooter who doesn't know how to pay his fair share! Once you manage to pay off the pirates, I'll chip in a gold bar of my own from my stash.

Thank you kindly for accommodating our request. Your generosity will allow us to expand to new islands. New “Pirate Islands.” Has a good ring to it!

You’ve been so helpful, we'd like to return the favor! If you find another Whisker colony and swear to let us know about it, I’ll make sure other pirates don’t trouble your island for a while. You have my word! 

And who knows? Mayhaps you’ll even find some empty islands we can turn into even more Pirate islands! Feels good to share, doesn't it?

Send my thanks to the colony for constructing this fine new ship. That old boat you found me in could never achieve what needs to be done! I’ll take it. Consider it your first donation to the cause!

For too long, our kind has toiled under the oppression of the Claws! Waiting for today, when a Whisker brave enough to start the rebellion decided to make the choice the cowards ignored. As I promised when we met, now I’ve made good on my promise and repaid your kindness.

Remember this day! Tell your children. Tell them you were there when Stormie left port and started the Whisker Rebellion!
We are looking to expand our donation base. If you know of any other Whisker colony looking to support our efforts, it would be a grand help.
If you cooperate we promise to protect your colony from other pirates for 8 days.
We're always on the lookout for any secret documents. Here is a scrap of paper. If you’ll share one of your schematics with us, it would be mightily appreciated!
Of course we appreciate such generosity. In return, I will personally vouch for your colony to the other pirates. You’ll be protected for 13 days.
Between our success against the Claws and the generosity of Whiskers colonies such as yours, we are in need of an island to expand operations onto. Do you know of any empty islands?
If you follow through on your end, we’ll consider it a favor and protect your colony for 8 days.
A nasty encounter with uncooperative Claws has left us in a bit of a tricky situation. May we ask for repair materials to compensate for the damage caused by your Claw masters?
By our good nature, I’ll throw in protection for 5 days. That means no visits from us or our friends.

We are recruiting! So long as you are not a Claw, there is a place for you in our crew. All skilled, able-bodied, and ship-shape Whiskers are encouraged to apply. In return, you'll get a share of our loot and full room and board!
What we are offering is 21 days of protection. On our honor, no other pirates will bother you while you are under our protection.

Nasty rumors of violent actions by a wayward Whisker should be ignored at all costs. These false whispers risk hurting the productivity of honest Whiskers and raising general rebellion levels.

These rumours are replete with lies of sinkings and theft of tax receipts. You should know that no supply ships have been sunk and no tax has been stolen. Pirate activity has been decimated, and their fleets are at the bottom of the ocean.

In keeping with our efforts to preserve peace and reassure all Whiskers of the safety to their tax contribution, extra ships have been deployed. To maintain pace of repairs, we’ve authorized Nails, Canned Food, and Sails to be accepted as tax payments. In compensation for this generosity, tax rates per Whisker have been increased.

Encouraging news to all loyal to the King! The rebel fool known as Stormie has been dispatched. His evil folly ends with him.

Now that your colony has been freed from the tyranny of Stormie, your donations are requested to reward the brave Claws who captured him. A couple Gold Bars would be appropriate.

PS: In celebration, the department has seen fit to gift schematics for cannons to your colony. Expect future requests for assistance as we bring these Pirate Wars to a quick end with minimal loss of Claw life.
Pending completion of this assignment, your colony will be granted 1 Letter of Recomendation.
Your colony had better put those cannons to good use. Find and sink us a Pirate ship for us.
Pirates are hiding on a yet-uncharted island. Consider this your official request to scout the ocean and identify the pirate hide out.
Reports indicate smugglers are active and undermining our trade policy. Drive up their cost of business and sink one for us.

Claws cannot be expected to suffer the total brunt of this Pirate War. Consider this your call to stand up and destroy 1 Pirate Island. Eliminate all their defenses and bombard any docks to rubble. Without a dock, the Pirates cannot rebuild their ships.
Your colony appears rather industrious. It is time you started paying your fair share.

One troublesome Pirate Island remains. But be wary. These Pirates have grown desperate and doubled their defenses. 

Were you to engage them in a protracted battle, I fear your losses would be great. Fortunately, we are not without recourse.

To assist in your fight, I’ve authorized the transfer of the Ironshot Schematic. These Iron Cannonballs have superior penetrating power against towers but require more complex production. 

Once you clear this final island and bring an end to the Pirate Wars, I’ve been authorized to nominate your colony for a King’s Reward. 

Normally such a reward would grant nobility, but as Whiskers you would instead receive independence.

Now, you must maintain patience. If rewarded, you would be the first Whiskers in history to receive such an honour. Yet it is appropriate. Your sailors have fought hard and your colony has paid in lives. I am honoured to fight alongside you.

News of your victory has reached my ears! What a glorious achievement!

I will submit your nomination hence forth! Please be patient as the entire evaluation may take several years.

Under the King’s Graceful Rule,
Admiral Birman
